title: mirror-registry
description: The pane mirror's durable session registry (~/.config/slot/serve/mirror-registry.json): which panes are piped to which spools, held by which serve process. Written BEFORE the pipe starts (rollback on failure) so a crashed serve leaves a registry the next startup sweep can reconcile against reality - a pipe with no registry entry is unfindable, a registry entry with a dead holder is sweepable. Single-writer by construction (the serve pidfile guarantees one instance); writes are atomic tmp+rename.

paneId.description: backend pane handle at open time

sink.description: absolute spool path receiving the bytes

pid.description: the serve process holding this session

mode.description: pipe = mux streamStart; poll = capture diff fallback
